steps.title: Getting started
steps.text:
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the hideout behind the Canifis pub.
  • This quest requires a lot of inventory space. Steps will tell you when it is best to bank if you don't have a beast of burden summoning familiar.

actions.text: I want to join your organisation.
Can you tell me about the job?

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue speaking to Veliaf Hurtz.

steps.title: Burgh de Rott
steps.text: Exit the cave.
Exit the tunnel through the wooden doors to the south.
Climb the tree to the south.
Board the boat to the south.
Speak to Florin, south of the bridge to Burgh de Rott.
Search the chest.

postconditions.text: recently has contained wrapped food packages

steps.text:
Use food on the chest.
  • If you need a piece of food, there are snails to the west of Mort'ton that can be cooked with level 12 Cooking.
Jump the gate.
Talk to Florin.

actions.text: Are there any 'out of the way' places in here?

steps.text: Climb over the broken down wall in the building just south-east of the well.
Mine the rubble to clear the trap door.
Open the trapdoor and climb down.

Mine and use spade to remove all the rubble piles (15).
  • Your bucket can be emptied on the pile outside the pub.
Exit the pub basement.
Talk to Razvan, south of the pub (any villager will do though).

actions.text: I'd like to help fix up the town.

steps.title: Fixing the general store
steps.text:
Talk to Aurel in the general store.
  • Bank after receiving a crate.

actions.text: I'd like to help fix up the town.

steps.text: Climb the ladder outside and use a plank on the Broken Roof.
Climb down and use a plank on the damaged wall.
Talk to Aurel.

Fill the box with supplies: 10 bronze hatchet, 3 tinderbox and 10 raw mackerel or raw snails. After filling the crate, right-click check its contents.
  • You can kill snails next to Mort'ton.
  • You can fish mackerel south of Burgh de Rott.
  • Check the in-game quest journal if you forget what Aurel asks for.

postconditions.text: You put 10 bronze axes in the crate.
This crate is packed with stock
You put 3 tinderboxes in the crate.
This crate is packed with stock
You put 10 snails in the crate.
You put 10 mackerels in the crate.
This crate is packed with stock

steps.text: Return the crate to Aurel.

steps.title: Fixing the bank
steps.text: Talk to Cornelius in the bank.

Use a plank on the bank booth.
  • You can buy some swamp paste in Mort'ton if you have Shades of Mort'ton completed.
Use a plank on the wall behind the booth.
Return to Cornelius.

steps.title: Fixing furnace
steps.text: Talk to Grigore (any villager will do though).

postconditions.text: old furnace were up and working

steps.text: Use a steel bar on the furnace to the east.
Use a piece of coal on the furnace.
Search the furnace to light it.

steps.title: Vampyre slayer
steps.text: Talk to Gadderanks in the general store.
Talk to the female Vampyre Juvinate.
Talk to the male Vampyre Juvinate.
Talk to Wiskit.
Talk to Gadderanks again.

Kill Gadderanks and the vampyres.
  • The vampyres can only be damaged by a silver melee weapon.
Talk to Gadderanks.

steps.title: Migrating the Myreque
steps.text: Talk to Veliaf.
Lodestone to Canifis.

Talk to Veliaf in the Canifis hideout.
  • Dismiss your followers if you have any.
Talk to Polmafi.
Talk to Radigad.

Use all steel armor, food, and a steel sickle on Ivan, then talk to him.
  • Route 1 is generally easier.

actions.text: Yes, I'll offer all of this food item in my inventory to Ivan.

steps.text: Kill the vampyres.
Enter the Mausoleum.
Talk to Drezel.

postconditions.text: If he has made such a claim

actions.text: Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis?

postconditions.text: that is as much as I

actions.text: The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!

steps.text: Use the key on the east wall.
Climb down the secret trapdoor.
Search the westernmost middle-bookcase for The Sleeping Seven.
Read the book.
steps.warning: There's not tracking for this step.

steps.title: Silvthril rod
steps.text: Lodestone to Canifis and enter the trapdoor south of the pub.
Enter the passage.
Smash the wooden boards on the eastern wall then enter.
Use soft clay on the tomb, then add the rod clay mould to your tool belt.
Smelt a silvthril rod at any furnace (under the Silver Casting section).
Enchant it using the Lvl-1 Enchant spell.
Use the enchanted silvthril rod on the well in the room west of Drezel to receive the rod of ivandis.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Go back to Burgh de Rott, and go to the cellar in the pub where you previously cleared the rubble.
Talk to Veliaf.

actions.text: I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis!
Yes, I've come to give the Rod of Ivandis to you!
